settings.heading: Sultan of Statues
settings.body: Sultan of Statues is a UK-based collectible statue business.

settings.heading: What we do
settings.body:
We buy, sell and take collectible statues on consignment — resin and polystone display pieces from specialist studios.

Every piece is described as accurately as we can. Where we do not yet know a detail — edition size, exact scale, the full contents of a box — we say so rather than guess.

Explore the collection or contact us about buying, selling or consignment.

settings.heading: Talk to us about a piece
settings.body: Questions about a statue, an order, selling your collection or consignment are all welcome.
